about: Narrow nature's clue photos never to use, by iNaturalist photo id, each with why. Mostly photos with a photographer's name, a web address or a caption written on them, which can give the place away as a credit line can (2026-11-26). scripts/build-day-list.mjs skips them, and --photos swaps any a list still uses for the species' next usable photo.
